HomePage.line2: Beyond delivery — We deliver growth and opportunity
HomePage.line3: Leveraging CU Mongolia, a strong vendor network, and advanced logistics capabilities, Premium United is building Mongolia’s first fully integrated supply chain platform.

AboutPage.title: About our company
AboutPage.description: Premium United was established in * with a mission to build Mongolia’s next-generation integrated food distribution and logistics ecosystem. Our operations unify wholesale distribution, cold-chain and processing, rural backhaul sourcing, Q-commerce, and last-mile delivery into a single, efficient, and transparent platform. Our ambition is to transform Mongolia’s food supply chain into a modern, integrated, and sustainable system — delivering growth, access, and opportunity to every province and every shop we serve.

BranchPage.title: Our partner branch companies
BranchPage.line1: Explore the significant milestones that have shaped our company. Each achievement reflects our commitment to excellence and innovation.

branch.name: Pemium Nexus JSC
branch.description: At Premium Nexus JSC, we redefine retail convenience with our CU-centric ecosystem, setting new standards in the Food and Beverage retail sector.

branch.name: Premium United
branch.description: Premium United partners with CU convenience stores to operate a centralized distribution center, including ambient and cold chain warehouses, along with transport and distribution services.

branch.name: CU
branch.description: Serving 200,000+ customers daily, this growing chain operates 410+ stores across Ulaanbaatar and 10 central provinces, delivering quality and convenience nationwide.

branch.name: Central Commerce
branch.description: Central Commerce operates as an import, marketing, and distribution powerhouse, supplying products across all sales channels. In 2023, it proudly partnered with Asahi Beer Asia Limited, expanding its portfolio to include a variety of Asahi products, such as the iconic Asahi Super Dry, now widely available throughout Mongolia.

branch.name: Central Coffee Roasting
branch.description: CCR roasts and packages premium coffee using German technology, delivering top-quality beans to CU stores and consumers.

branch.name: Stora Central
branch.description: Stora’s seamless e-commerce platform integrates with Amazon and Taobao, using Amazon’s inventory system to ensure fast overseas delivery directly to Stora Boxes in CU stores.

branch.name: Chinggis Beer
branch.description: Established in 1997, Chinggis Beer is a leading Mongolian brand known for its premium pilsner, crafted with quality European raw materials to deliver a unique bitter flavor and crystal-clear refreshment.
